class.name: HTMLTemplateElement
class.brief_description: An HTML template that holds reusable content in a detached fragment.
class.description: Query a [code]<template>[/code] element or create one with [method HTMLLayout.create_element]. Its content stays outside document queries and layout until inserted. To reuse a template, call [method HTMLDocumentFragment.clone_node] with [code]true[/code] on [member content] and pass the result to [method HTMLElement.append_fragment]. Each insertion empties the supplied fragment. Use [method HTMLElement.get_inner_html] and [method HTMLElement.set_inner_html] to read or replace the fragment's markup. Use [member content] for tree edits. The template itself accepts no direct children. A shallow copy of the template has empty content. A deep copy includes its content and any nested templates. [method HTMLLayout.adopt_node] transfers the content fragment and its existing handles with the template. Like the template, the fragment follows the lifetime of its owning layout.

members.member: The template's persistent content fragment. Returns [code]null[/code] if the template handle is invalid.
